notes: Version 1.0.260 — 22 languages, PDF report settings window with editable texts, collapsible menu, instruction pop-up in the client selection report.
changelog: 8 new languages: Ukrainian, Turkish, Romanian, Czech, Serbian, Slovak, Hungarian and Dutch — 22 languages in the app, HTML, PDF and .acerep reports, sorted alphabetically.
PDF report settings window: choose sections and top folders (automatic or your own), edit every text and see a live preview.
Editable default texts: PDF texts, client information, pop-up text and RAW description are filled in, ready to adjust — the ↺ icon restores the default text of a single field.
Collapsible menu sections in the Generator and Settings — the app remembers which ones you keep open.
Client selection report (.acerep): instruction pop-up for the client with one-click copy of your e-mail address and a reminder after downloading the .roa file.
Very large folders (millions of files) are listed in full.
Live preview of the classic view shows the real report with your data.
